name: Super Car Racer
description: Super Car Racer is an action-packed racing game that will test your driving skills to the limit. Get behind the wheel of some of the world's most powerful and exotic cars and compete in high-speed races across a variety of tracks and terrains. With stunning graphics and realistic physics, Super Car Racer is the ultimate racing experience.  Super Car Racer features multiple game modes, including single-player career mode, time trials, and online multiplayer. In career mode, you'll start as a novice driver and work your way up the ranks, competing in increasingly challenging races and unlocking new cars and tracks. Time trials let you test your skills against the clock, while online multiplayer lets you compete against other players from around the world.  The game features a wide range of cars, from sleek sports cars to powerful muscle cars to futuristic supercars. Each car has its own unique handling and performance characteristics, so you'll need to master them all to become a top racer. You can customize your cars with a variety of paint schemes, decals, and performance upgrades to make them truly your own.
